high_level_description: A documentary photograph of a busy morning fish market in a Mediterranean harbour town, vendors and shoppers, crates of fresh fish on ice.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Open market square next to a harbour with colourful fishing boats moored behind, whitewashed buildings with blue shutters, bright overcast morning light.

elements.desc: Middle-aged vendor with a grey moustache and a blue rubber apron holding up a large silver sea bream to show a customer.
Customer, a young woman with a canvas tote bag and sunglasses on her head, pointing at a crate.
Long table of wooden crates filled with crushed ice, sardines, octopus, red mullet and lemons.
Hand-written white chalk letters on a small blackboard leaning against the table, uppercase, regular, upright, small.
Seagull standing on a mooring post at the right edge of the frame.
